personal.title: ARCHITECT
personal.summary: Architect with 10+ years of experience leading multidisciplinary teams on complex projects across diverse sectors. Combines strong design leadership with deep technical expertise in computational design, and workflow automation through Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, Python, and C#. Consistently delivers measurable gains in project quality, efficiency, and outcomes by integrating concept design, design development, and digital innovation.

experience.title: Principal Architect / Advanced Technology Lead
experience.responsibilities: Initialising and leading the architectural design of international projects across multiple sectors. Building the computational design and digital innovation capabilities of the practice, including developing custom tools and workflows that integrate concept design, design development, digital delivery and automation. Collaborating with architects, clients, and consultants to drive design excellence and project success through innovative use of technology.
notableProjects: Renovation BIM modeling for Berlin City Library, Germany, leading the BIM and architectural team.
Master plan project in Abu Dhabi, UAE
Computational design and design optimization consultancy for master plan components of the Trojena mountain development in Saudi Arabia.
Computational design and design optimization for a large retail project in Dubai, UAE.
System design and concept design of an automated housing platform startup.

Mentoring consultancy on computational design.

Computational design and design optimization consultancy for master plan components of the Trojena mountain development in Saudi Arabia.
